batch-changes-description: Batch Changes makes it easy to find and change code across many repositories (or many subtrees in a big monorepo). It lets you create, update, and track pull requests to ensure the change is reviewed, tested, and safely merged everywhere.
contact-sales-trial-license: <0>Contact sales</0> to obtain a trial license.
batch-changes-sign-commits-github-apps: Batch Changes can now <0>sign commits</0>  created on GitHub via GitHub Apps.
site-admins-configure-github-app-integra: Site admins can <0>configure a GitHub App integration</0>  to enable this feature.
github-app-commit-signing-integration-se: GitHub App commit signing integrations can be configured by site admins and viewed from <0>your user settings</0> .
batch-changes-supports-gerrit: Batch Changes now supports Gerrit. To start publishing Gerrit Changes, add your user credentials.
batch-changes-per-batch-change-control: Batch Changes now supports per-batch-change control for pushing to a fork of the upstream repository with the batch spec property <0>changesetTemplate.fork</0> .
batch-changes-automatic-branch-deletion: Branches created by Batch Changes can now be automatically deleted on the code host upon merging or closing a changeset by enabling the site config setting <0>batchChanges.autoDeleteBranch</0> .
no-batch-changes-created: No batch changes have been created.
update-configuration-files: Update configuration files across many repositories
try-it-yourself-prompt: Try it yourself in less than 10 minutes (without actually pushing changes).
